{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Chunky wool sweater, relaxed fit, hip length, oatmeal beige (#D8C8B0), soft merino-wool knit with a rib-knit crew neckline

Straight-leg jeans, high waist, full length, dark indigo (#2B3A55), sturdy cotton denim

Ankle boots, low block heel, round toe, chocolate brown (#5A3E30), smooth leather

Wool scarf, wide and long, dusty blue (#7F93A8), brushed wool

Knit beanie, snug fit, cuffed, warm grey (#8A8584), soft wool blend

Crossbody bag, compact, structured, cognac (#A0643A), leather

Lined wool-blend coat, straight cut, knee length, camel (#B8926A), brushed wool blend with a soft finish

This outfit gives you the cozy wool sweater you asked for, and the thick knit with the scarf and beanie keeps you properly warm on an autumn walk. The oatmeal tone and dusty blue scarf are soft and gentle against your fair skin and echo the cool blue of your eyes, while the dark denim and chocolate boots ground the look with your deep hair color. The relaxed sweater over high-waisted straight jeans keeps the silhouette balanced and comfortable for walking, and the camel coat adds a polished layer for the cool air. Everything stays in warm, natural neutrals, so it feels calm, put together and easy to wear."}
